title: 第13章 秘密差点泄露第14章 五百功德点
lines: 最后一个卷轴打开，李卓阳顿时呆立当场。
这……这么简单的吗？
李卓阳简直不敢相信自己的眼睛，再三确认后才相信这是真的。
原来，这个任务只是简单地让上交五十块紫阳石。
不过李卓阳转瞬间就想明白了，这任务并不简单，只是对自己来说比较简单罢了。
普通的外门挖矿弟子，平均每十天才能挖到一块紫阳石。
纵使有谁运气爆棚，也最多挖个三四块，想要在剩余的十几天挖到五十块，简直难如登天！
但是对于李卓阳来说，这任务简直跟白送一样。
“哈哈哈，”此时，旁边那个管事看着呆立的李卓阳，忽然绷不住，哈哈大笑起来。
“哈哈哈……”在其身后，另一个笑声也传了过来。
李卓阳回身一看，此人赫然便是田持弓。
“李师弟，到底有没有想好选择哪个任务啊？”
田持弓戏谑地看着李卓阳道：“依我说，你还是选择挖矿这个任务吧，若是最后实在挖不到紫阳石，把你家的杂货铺卖了，或许差不多就能凑够了。”
李卓阳听到此话，不怒反笑。
“多谢田师兄提醒，我就选择这个任务了。”
说着，他把那个卷轴重新卷了起来，拿在手里，向田姓管事道：“请这位田师兄帮我登记吧。”
李卓阳的反应，显然出乎了田持弓的意料：“李卓阳，你可要看清楚，那是五十块，不是五块，要是在剩下的十几天里你交不上来，可是会被逐出宗门的。”
“这上面大大的字，我当然看的清，至于能不能交的出，就不劳师兄费心了。”
说完，他大步朝殿外走去，只留田氏哥俩面面相觑。
田持弓脸色有些阴沉，他没想到李卓阳居然真的敢接下这个任务。
“小弓，不用担心。”
田管事拍了拍田持弓的肩膀，“他一个刚到炼气四层的弟子，怎么可能在十几天弄得到五十块紫阳石，到时候交不出任务，咱们再好好收拾他。”
田持弓咬了咬牙，点了点头，到时候他一定要让李卓阳灰头土脸地离开紫阳宗。
届时，孔老大一高兴，说不定又能赏赐点好东西。
李卓阳离开任务殿后，便直接出了宗门，朝紫阳矿区方向走去。
离开宗门三里左右，见四下无人，李卓阳当即用幻形功能改变了容貌，然后祭出闪云梭，瞬间离地而去。
半个时辰后，李卓阳直接进入了一家赌石场。
这家赌石场规模颇大，前两天，李卓阳才在此挑走了大约三十块紫阳石，只占据此地紫阳石的三分之一左右数量。
故而，李卓阳此次返回赌石场，第一个想到的就是来这里，再挑走大约二十块。
这样剩下一半儿的紫阳石也足以让这家赌石场正常运转了。
此时，赌石场正是人头攒动之际。
李卓阳也不着急，跟在三个中年修士身后，看似随意地挑挑拣拣。
不多会儿，他就已经将五块紫阳石收入囊中。
三个修士显然也是进来消遣，并未用心识别，只是随手拿了几块矿石。
“大哥，你有没有听说，昨日丙字区十三号矿洞，挖出了一块紫阳玉。”
“老二，你不是开玩笑吧？这里还能挖到紫阳玉？”
“二哥可知道是谁挖走的？”
“是外门的秦老三，不过此人相当机警，知道这样的宝贝，不是他能持有的。第一时间就偷偷地将紫阳玉带到了宗门，献给了田长老。”
“是他啊，怪不得今天听说这厮要升任矿区管事了，原来是这个原因。”
content_en:
When the last scroll was opened, Li Zhuoyang stood stunned on the spot.
Is this... so simple?
Li Zhuoyang couldn't believe his eyes, and only after confirming it repeatedly did he believe it was true.
It turns out that this task is simply to hand over fifty purple sun stones.
However, Li Zhuoyang figured out in an instant that this task was not simple, but it was relatively simple for him.
Ordinary outer sect mining disciples can dig out one Ziyang Stone every ten days on average.
Even if someone is extremely lucky, they can only dig out three or four yuan at most. It would be extremely difficult to dig out fifty yuan in the remaining ten days!
But for Li Zhuoyang, this task was like giving it away for free.
"Hahaha," at this time, the steward next to him looked at Li Zhuoyang, who was standing still, and suddenly couldn't hold himself back and burst into laughter.
"Hahaha..." Behind him, another laugh came.
Li Zhuoyang turned around and saw that this person was Tian Zhigong.
"Junior Brother Li, have you decided which mission to choose?"
Tian Chigong looked at Li Zhuoyang jokingly and said: "In my opinion, you should choose the mining task. If you really can't dig out the Ziyang Stone in the end, you might be able to get enough by selling your grocery store."
When Li Zhuoyang heard this, he smiled instead of being angry.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Tian, for reminding me, I will choose this mission."
As he spoke, he rolled up the scroll again, held it in his hand, and said to the steward surnamed Tian: "Please ask Senior Brother Tian to help me register."
Li Zhuoyang's reaction was obviously beyond Tian Chigong's expectation: "Li Zhuoyang, you have to see clearly, that is fifty yuan, not five yuan. If you fail to pay it in the remaining ten days, you will be expelled from the sect."
"Of course I can read the big words on it clearly. As for whether I can hand it over, I won't bother my senior brother."
After saying that, he strode out of the palace, leaving the Tian brothers alone looking at each other.
Tian Chigong's face was a little gloomy. He didn't expect that Li Zhuoyang actually dared to take on this task.
"Xiao Gong, don't worry."
Manager Tian patted Tian Zhigong on the shoulder, "How could he, a disciple who has just arrived at the fourth level of Qi Refining, obtain fifty Purple Sunstones in ten days? If he can't hand in the task by then, let's take care of him."
Tian Chi Gong gritted his teeth and nodded. When the time comes, he must let Li Zhuoyang leave the Ziyang Sect in disgrace.
At that time, when Boss Kong is happy, he might be able to reward him with something good.
After Li Zhuoyang left the mission hall, he went directly out of the sect and walked towards the Ziyang mining area.
About three miles away from the sect, seeing no one around, Li Zhuoyang immediately used his morphing function to change his appearance, then used the Flashing Cloud Shuttle and left the ground in an instant.
Half an hour later, Li Zhuoyang directly entered a stone betting shop.
This stone gambling center is quite large. In the past two days, Li Zhuoyang picked out about thirty pieces of purple sun stones, which only accounted for about one-third of the number of purple sun stones here.
Therefore, when Li Zhuoyang returned to the stone gambling den, the first thing he thought of was to come here and pick away about twenty yuan.
In this way, the remaining half of the purple sunstone is enough for the normal operation of this stone gambling center.
At this time, the stone betting ground was crowded with people.
Li Zhuoyang was not in a hurry and followed the three middle-aged monks, picking and choosing seemingly casually.
In a short while, he had already collected five purple sun stones in his pocket.
The three monks obviously came in to have fun. They didn't identify it carefully and just took a few pieces of ore.
"Brother, have you heard that a piece of Purple Sun Jade was dug out in Mine No. 13 in Area C yesterday?"
"Second brother, are you kidding me? Can you find purple sun jade here?"
"Second brother, do you know who poached it?"
"It was Qin Laosan from the outer sect, but he was quite alert and knew that he could not hold such a treasure. He immediately secretly brought the Purple Sun Jade to the sect and presented it to Elder Tian."
"It's him. No wonder I heard today that this guy is going to be promoted to mine manager. It turns out that's the reason."
